records.text: A Vile Scarab is a scarab creature.
A Hive'Zara Drone is a hive creature.
A Hive'Zara Collector is a hive creature whose combat response includes Deafening Screech.
A Hive'Zara Soldier is a hive fighter. It can answer an attack with Retaliation.
A Hive'Zara Sandstalker is a hive creature that can burrow during combat.
A Qiraji Gladiator is a combatant that can become enraged.
A hive wasp of Hive'Zara, found across the hive's areas. It uses Itch against nearby targets.
A Hive'Zara stinger, one of the hive's local creatures.
A silicate feeder found in the Hive'Zara area. When it dies, it releases a Cloud of Disease.
A flesh hunter of the Hive'Zara area. It uses Thrash.
A Hive'Zara tail lasher found in the hive.
An obsidian destroyer found in the Hive'Zara area.

Ossirian is a powerful Qiraji defender who orders his forces to protect the city and drive out trespassers. He speaks of renewed power in battle, and his warnings frame the conflict as a defense of the city against intruders.
Moam draws on its opponents’ mana and turns to stone during battle. Its energy swells as its mana reaches fullness.

General Rajaxx leads the Qiraji assault with a call for vengeance, promising that even the dragons will feel their wrath. His anger is personal toward Fandral, whom he taunts to hide in the Emerald Dream. He threatens mortals who interfere and speaks of a master nearing restoration.
A Qiraji Swarmguard uses Sundering Cleave at close range.
A Swarmguard Needler uses Cleave during combat.

Kurinnaxx is a venomous beast encountered in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj. Dirk Thunderwood seeks its venom sac as an ingredient for a poison compound, making Kurinnaxx a sought-after source of venom as well as an encounter foe.
Anubisath Guardian is a recurring guardian encounter in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.
Ayamiss the Hunter is a named boss encounter in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj. Its frenzy is marked by a visible emote, giving attackers a clear sign of its changing combat state.
Buru the Gorger is a named boss encounter in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj. In combat, its target emote signals when it fixes its attention on someone.
Colonel Zerran is a named combatant in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj. In combat, he casts Sunder Armor against an opponent.
Major Yeggeth is a named combatant in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj. In combat, he casts Sunder Armor against an opponent.
A Qiraji Warrior is a rank-and-file combatant. It uses an uppercut and goes into a frenzy.
Major Pakkon is a named dungeon combatant. His combat actions include Sunder Armor, Sweeping Slam and Cleave.
Captain Drenn is a named dungeon combatant. He uses Sunder Armor in combat.
Captain Xurrem is a named dungeon combatant. He uses Sunder Armor in combat.
Captain Qeez is a named dungeon combatant. He uses Sunder Armor in combat.
Captain Tuubid is a named dungeon combatant. He uses Sunder Armor in combat.
A Shrieker Scarab is a scarab combatant found among others of its kind. It uses Berserker Charge in combat.
A scarab that charges and spits acid during combat.
A beast, Canal Frenzy uses Pierce Armor against nearby opponents.

place_records.text: You are in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj, a Qiraji city entered through the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj. Qiraji forces hold it, and Ossirian the Unscarred orders them to protect the city and drive out trespassers. General Rajaxx and Moam hold other parts of it. Hive'Zara wasps and stingers, scarabs, Qiraji warriors and Anubisath guardians fill it.
You are in Scarab Terrace, a part of the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj. Hive'Zara wasps and stingers fill it, along with Qiraji swarmguards and gladiators. Vile Scarabs are found here too.

You are in General's Terrace, a part of the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj where General Rajaxx leads Qiraji forces. Colonel Zerran, Major Yeggeth, Major Pakkon and Captain Drenn are its officers, alongside Qiraji warriors, swarmguard needlers and gladiators.
You are in The Reservoir, a part of the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj where Moam is found. Shrieker and spitting scarabs share it with Obsidian Destroyers and Flesh Hunters. Vile Scarabs are found here too.

You are in The Hatchery, a part of the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj where Buru the Gorger is found. Hive'Zara soldiers, sandstalkers, drones, collectors and tail lashers are here, with Buru eggs and Flesh Hunters. Silicate feeders are found here too.
You are in The Comb, a part of the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj where Ayamiss the Hunter is found. Hive'Zara wasps and stingers fill it alongside Ayamiss, and silicate feeders are found here too.
You are in Watchers' Terrace, a part of the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj where Ossirian the Unscarred, a Qiraji defender, keeps watch. Anubisath guardians are with him.
